semantic_objects.projection: Self-diagnosis can be systematically less sensitive to one's own bias than to others' bias.
semantic_objects.rakl_transition: Same-context introspection remains a proposal/diagnostic route and cannot receive independent-review authority merely because it is introspective.

semantic_objects.projection: Requiring explicit explanatory reconstruction can reveal missing inferential/mechanistic structure and can support learning.
semantic_objects.rakl_transition: Freeze required explanation elements and treat the missing set as an explicit residual; generated explanation itself remains proposal-authority only.

semantic_objects.projection: Explicit consideration of an opposing possibility can outperform generic instructions to be unbiased in correcting biased judgment.
semantic_objects.rakl_transition: A completed adversarial challenge must contain an explicit countermodel, differing assumptions, and potential discriminator; generic reflection language is insufficient.

semantic_objects.projection: Adopting a distanced perspective can reduce some self/other asymmetries in reasoning.
semantic_objects.rakl_transition: Add outside-view review as a route, but keep process/context and evidence-lineage independence as separate authority requirements.
semantic_objects.dedup_note: RAKL already distinguishes same-context reflection from independent review; psychology supplies a new motivation/projection, not a new independence rule.

semantic_objects.projection: Feedback can improve calibration/response strategy without improving underlying metacognitive sensitivity.
semantic_objects.rakl_transition: Represent calibration change and task-capability change as distinct coordinates; prohibit silent authority transition between them.

semantic_objects.projection: Confidence reporting/reflection can interfere with task performance in some settings.
semantic_objects.rakl_transition: Metacognitive audits are trigger- and value-gated actions rather than continuous mandatory loops.

semantic_objects.projection: The reported LLM benchmark finds domain-specific self-knowledge and a knowing-doing gap; external metacognitive control outperforms merely informing a model of its calibration in the reported setting.
semantic_objects.rakl_transition: Put metacognitive monitor/control in the RAKL runtime around the replaceable model; model self-report is one input, never canonical control authority.
semantic_objects.evidence_note: Recent preprint; retain source-specific scope and do not globalize.

semantic_objects.projection: Useful intellectual humility is expressed behaviorally through revisability rather than verbal self-deprecation.
semantic_objects.rakl_transition: Define humility operationally as evidence-responsive authority withdrawal, CANNOT_CHECK, negative-history preservation, and openness to independently supported challengers.

retained_rakl_candidate: A scientific-method completeness controller integrating externally measured metacognitive diagnostics with target reachability, residual ontology, typed scientific authority, negative history, independent evidence lineage, and governed self-evolution.

saturation.reason: held-out missing-operator discovery, conceptual-basis independence, and cost-sensitive trigger policy remain untested
